events.text: how much is standard delivery

events.query: how much is standard delivery

events.text: Standard delivery costs £3.95, but it's free if your order is over £40 [KB-101]. It typically takes 3 to 5 working days and is available across the United Kingdom, Ireland, and selected EU countries.
Is there free delivery over a certain amount?

events.query: Is there free delivery over a certain amount?

events.text: Yes, there is! Standard delivery is free on all orders over £40 [KB-101]. Alternatively, if you are ordering a large item, those have their own delivery costs. Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 working days.

events.text: Can I return something if I've used it once?

events.query: Can I return something if I've used it once?

events.text: Our policy on returns is outlined in our help-centre articles. For hygiene and safety reasons, we cannot accept returns for items such as pillows, duvets, or mattress toppers once they have been unsealed [KB-109]. You can find more details about items we can't take back on the help-centre site.
Do you deliver to Germany?

events.query: Do you deliver to Germany?

events.text:
Yes, we do deliver to Germany! According to our help centre, we deliver to several countries outside the UK, including Germany, France, and Spain [KB-113].

Please remember that international standard delivery takes 5 to 8 working days and costs £9.95. Let me know if you have any other questions about our policies.
Do you take Apple Pay?

events.query: Do you take Apple Pay?

events.text: Yes, we do! We accept Apple Pay, along with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and gift cards. You can find full details about accepted payment methods in our help centre [KB-110].
My parcel tracking hasn't updated for two days, is that normal?

events.query: My parcel tracking hasn't updated for two days, is that normal?

events.text: It's normal for tracking updates to take some time, as they can take up to 24 hours to appear [KB-102]. If you're concerned because it hasn't updated, please remember that we advise contacting us if the tracking hasn't changed for three working days [KB-103].
Can I use a promo code after I've paid?

events.query: Can I use a promo code after I've paid?

events.text: Unfortunately, no. Promotion codes must be entered at the checkout stage and cannot be added to an order once it has been placed [KB-114]. We also only allow one code per order.
Do you price match other shops?

events.query: Do you price match other shops?

events.text: Thanks for getting in touch. Unfortunately, we don't offer price matching with other retailers, but all the prices on our website already include VAT [KB-114]. Let me know if you have any other questions about your order or our policies!
how long do refunds take to show on my card

events.query: how long do refunds take to show on my card

events.text: Once a refund has been issued, it typically takes 5 to 10 working days for the money to appear in your account, depending on your bank [KB-105]. Please note that we refund to your original payment method. Let me know if you have any other questions about our policies!
What's your returns window?

events.query: What's your returns window?

events.text: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery [KB-104]. To be eligible, items must be unused and still in their original packaging. You can start a return by going to My orders and selecting the item, then choosing 'Return'.
Can I send back a personalised item?

events.query: Can I send back a personalised item?

events.text: I'm afraid that we can't accept returns for personalised or engraved items due to hygiene and safety reasons [KB-109]. This policy applies even if the item is unused. If your item is damaged or faulty, please check our guidelines on that, as those rules are different [KB-106].
Is returning from Ireland free?

events.query: Is returning from Ireland free?

events.text: I can confirm that returns from Ireland are not free. According to our help centre, returns from Ireland and the EU will cost £6.95, which will be deducted from your refund amount [KB-104]. To start the return process, please head to My orders and select the item you wish to return.
Are gift cards refundable?

events.query: Are gift cards refundable?

events.text: I'm afraid gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash or refunded [KB-111]. However, if you return an item that was paid for with a gift card, the refund will be issued back to you as a new gift card [KB-111].
What hours is customer care open?

events.query: What hours is customer care open?

events.text: Our customer care team is available Monday to Friday, from 9am to 6pm UK time, and on Saturday from 10am to 4pm [KB-112]. If you need anything outside these hours, you can ask the support assistant to pass you to a person, and they will reply by email by the end of the next working day [KB-112].
How do I change the address on my order?

events.query: How do I change the address on my order?

events.text: You can change your delivery address if your order is still in the **Processing** stage; just open **My orders** and select **Change address** [KB-108]. Please note that once an order has been dispatched, we are unable to change the address for security reasons [KB-108].
Can I pay in instalments?

events.query: Can I pay in instalments?

events.text: I don't have any information about instalment payments in our help articles. Would you like me to pass you to a person who can look into this for you?
If I order express before 2pm does it go today?

events.query: If I order express before 2pm does it go today?

events.text: For express delivery, if you order before 2 pm, your order will be dispatched on the same working day [KB-101]. Just remember that working days are Monday to Friday, and this does not include any UK bank holidays.
Do prices include VAT?

events.query: Do prices include VAT?

events.text: Yes, they do! According to our help centre, all prices shown on the Hollow Lane website already include VAT [KB-114].
Do you sell outdoor furniture?

events.query: Do you sell outdoor furniture?

events.text: I do not have information about whether we sell outdoor furniture in our help-centre articles. Would you like me to pass you to a person who will be happy to help you with this?
My parcel says delivered but I can't find it anywhere

events.query: My parcel says delivered but I can't find it anywhere

events.text: I'm sorry to hear that your parcel seems to have vanished! If tracking says it's delivered but you can't find it, please try checking with your neighbours or any safe place you might have given the courier. If it's still missing afterwards, please provide your order number so we can look into it further.
How do I cancel something I just ordered?

events.query: How do I cancel something I just ordered?

events.text: You can cancel your order if its status is **Processing** [KB-107]. To do this, please go to **My orders** in your account and select the option to cancel the order. Please note that once an order has been Dispatched, it cannot be cancelled [KB-107].
Can I return a rug that's been on the floor for a week?

events.query: Can I return a rug that's been on the floor for a week?

events.text: Under normal circumstances, you can return most items within 30 days of delivery, provided they are unused and in their original packaging [KB-104]. As the rug has been on the floor, it may not meet the 'unused' requirement for a standard return. To check your specific return options, please go to 'My orders' on our website [KB-104].
Something I bought went on sale 3 days later. Can I get the difference?

events.query: Something I bought went on sale 3 days later. Can I get the difference?

events.text: I'm afraid we can't refund the price difference if an item you purchased goes on sale afterwards. Our policy states that if an item goes on sale within 7 days of your order, we don't refund the difference [KB-114]. I hope this helps clarify things!

How long are your gift cards valid?

events.query: How long are your gift cards valid?

events.text: Hollow Lane gift cards are valid for 24 months from the date of purchase [KB-111]. You can use them on any order, and they can't be exchanged for cash. Do let me know if you have any other questions!
Will a sofa come by two-person delivery?

events.query: Will a sofa come by two-person delivery?

events.text: Yes, sofas are considered large items and will be delivered by a two-person courier [KB-101]. This service takes between 5 to 10 working days and costs £29.

events.text: Yes, we do ship to Belgium! International standard delivery to the country takes 5 to 8 working days. Please note that all import taxes and duties are included in the price, so there are no extra charges upon arrival [KB-113].

events.query: Can I return bedding if the packet is opened?

events.text: You can return most items for a refund, provided they are unused and still in their original packaging [KB-104]. This general rule applies to most of our products, so I suggest checking the return instructions on the 'My orders' page to see if bedding has any specific exceptions.

events.text: You do not always have to pay to return an item! Returns are free for addresses within the UK [KB-104]. However, please note that returns from Ireland and the EU will cost £6.95, which will be deducted from your refund [KB-104].
